Renders each page to an image and rebuilds the PDF — the biggest saving on scanned documents. Text stops being selectable, so keep the original.

Password protect

AES-256, applied when you save. Leave the user password empty to set an owner password only.

Unlock a PDF

Remove a password you already know. The file is decrypted here, not sent anywhere.

Extract text

Pull the text out of the loaded pages — one .txt per source file.

OCR not loaded

Reads text from scans. The recognition engine (~7 MB) is downloaded once and then cached by your browser; after that it works offline. Your document is never uploaded — only the engine is downloaded.
